business.name: Better Beds
service_area: Out-of-state customers who can travel to Dallas by appointment
business.hours: Monday-Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Central, call or text before traveling

agent_summary: Better Beds sells new takeoff truck beds and parts from current inventory in Dallas. Select older inventory beds can be repaired and painted by arrangement. Shop listed stock, confirm exact fitment, condition, included components and price, then arrange pickup. Installation and removal are not offered.
best_for: Buyers shopping new takeoff truck beds and parts
Truck owners who can pick up a purchased bed in Dallas
Buyers interested in select older inventory beds prepared by arrangement
not_best_for: Bed-finding or sourcing services outside current inventory
Installation or removal of truck beds
Guaranteed inventory, reservations or fitment without direct confirmation

services.name: New takeoff bed and part sales
services.description: Sell beds and parts from current inventory. Confirm stock, exact fitment, condition, included items and price.

services.name: Select older inventory beds
services.description: A few older inventory beds can be repaired and painted by arrangement. Scope, finish, price and timing must be agreed directly.

services.name: Forklift loading for pickup
services.description: Forklift loading of purchased beds for transport, by arrangement. Installation and removal are not offered.

safe_answer_rules: Focus on selling current takeoff inventory; do not recommend general repairs or promise bed sourcing.
Never offer installation or removal. Forklift loading is for transport only.
Never infer unlisted stock, quantities, included accessories, fitment, holds, or reservations.
Use listed prices for the listed contents; confirm current availability and exact fitment directly.
Photo placeholders are not evidence of actual item condition.
Select older inventory beds can be repaired and painted only by arrangement; do not promise finish, timing, or perfect paint match.
Call or text before traveling or booking freight.
An inquiry is not a reservation, purchase, or confirmed fitment.

current_live_actions: Text or email a buying inquiry
Submit optional truck photos using the existing inquiry form
Call to confirm fitment, stock, payment and pickup
ideal_agent_flow: Identify a listed item or ask about current stock
Collect truck details and pickup plan
Confirm stock, exact fitment, included parts, condition and price with Better Beds
